name: truncated_result
description: A tool result capped by core.HeadTailBuffer keeps its explicit [... omitted_bytes=N ...] marker all the way into the provider request, so the model KNOWS the output was cut instead of trusting a silently truncated result.

steps.note: model asks for the big output

deltas.content: The output was truncated — the omitted_bytes marker is present; head starts with HEAD-START and the tail ends with TAIL-END.
